underlines.text: I hope Mr. Bingley will like it, Lizzy.

reference.text: Observing his second daughter employed in trimming a hat, he suddenly addressed her with,—

underlines.text: since we are not to visit

reference.text: He had always intended to visit him, though to the last always assuring his wife that he should not go; and till the evening after the visit was paid she had no knowledge of it.
